title: DOM HTML-injection sinks are refused in app modules
intent: dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML/outerHTML assignment, insertAdjacentHTML and document.write inject markup that bypasses the framework's output escaping — the canonical XSS sink. Rich text renders through the stack's sanctioned rich-text component instead.
reference: The Markdown component from @terpjs/react-core for rich text.

runtime.rationale: The sinks are platform primitives on every element; React's default output escaping is the ambient constructive protection and the sanctioned Markdown component sanitises rich text. A runtime hook over every element's HTML mutation is not a seam react-core owns or could make sound -- vendored code legitimately uses the same primitives.
